questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical automation skills for SAP HANA backup reliability, emphasizing serverless event-driven verification, durable state management, and timely alerting mechanisms.

## Key Concepts
- S3 versioning with encrypted backup storage
- Lambda event-driven processing on S3 PUT operations
- Backup integrity verification using cryptographic checksums
- Durable result storage via DynamoDB
- Automated alerting through SNS or CloudWatch

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudocode: verify backup integrity
function verifyBackup(backupKey) {
  const actual = computeChecksum(backupData);
  const expected = getExpectedChecksum(backupKey);
  
  const result = {
    backupKey,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: actual === expected ? 'verified' : 'failed',
    actualChecksum: actual,
    expectedChecksum: expected
  };
  
  // Record in DynamoDB for durability
  dynamoDB.put(result);
  
  // Alert on failures
  if (result.status === 'failed') {
    sns.publish({
      message: `Backup integrity check failed for ${backupKey}`,
      subject: 'SAP HANA Backup Alert'
    });
  }
  
  return result;
}
```

## CloudFormation Example
```yaml
Resources:
  BackupVerificationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SAP-HANA-BackupVerificationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::your-backup-bucket/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::your-backup-bucket
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/backup-verification-results
        - PolicyName: SNSAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: arn:aws:sns:*:*:backup-alerts
```

```yaml
Resources:
  PatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
```

```yaml
# Minimal CloudFormation to create bucket and Lambda role
Resources:
  SAPAuditBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: sap-audit-bucket
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
  SAPAuditLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPAuditPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${SAPAuditBucket.Arn}/*'
```

## Why This Is Asked

- AWS Backup with cross-region replication

- IAM roles with least-privilege principles

- AWS CloudTrail for audit logging
- DR testing to validate RPO/RTO targets

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cross-account KMS key for SAP backups
Resources:
  SAPBackupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SAP backup encryption
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: sap-backup-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow AWS Backup Service
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalAccount:
                  - !Ref ProdAccountId
                  - !Ref DRAccountId
  BackupVaultPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: sap-primary-vault
      BackupVaultPolicy:
        Version: '2010-09-09'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Allow Cross Account Backup
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${ProdAccountId}:role/BackupServiceRole
            Action:
              - backup:PutBackupVaultAccessPolicy
              - backup:ListBackupVaults
              - backup:DescribeBackupVault
            Resource: !GetAtt SAPBackupKey.Arn
```
